title: ZA-2024-1560-CU1-1A
text:
ZA-2024-1560-CU1-1A  Council District 14 – Jurado
  CEQA: ENV-2024-1561-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-28-26
  Plan Area: Northeast Los Angeles  Continued from: 08-26-26, 09-09-26

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  4849 – 4853 North Mount Royal Drive

  The Planning Department is recommending that this matter be continued.

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  Construction, use, and maintenance of a new 3,560 square-foot single family dwelling and attached garage
  with an 18-foot wide, 34-foot long driveway bridge. The Applicant requests a Class 1 Conditional Use
  Permit to allow the construction of a new single-family dwelling on a Substandard Hillside Street (Mt. Royal
  Drive) improved with a roadway width less than 20 feet and that does not have vehicular access from a
  street improved with a minimum of 20-foot wide continuous paved roadway to the boundary of the Hillside
  Area, to allow a zero-foot front yard setback in lieu of the 19 feet, 10 inches otherwise required, and to
  allow a height of 45 feet in lieu of the maximum of 28 feet. The Project also includes nine protected Coast
  Live Oak trees, of which two protected trees (Tree #2 and Tree #3) are to be removed and replaced by
  eight new Coast Live Oak trees planted on site.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the June 8, 2026, Zoning Administrator's Determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Sections 15303, Class 3
  (New Construction and Conversion of Small Structures), and there is no substantial evidence
  demonstrating that any exceptions contained in Section 15300.2 of the state CEQA Guidelines
  regarding location, cumulative impacts, significant effects or unusual circumstances, scenic highways,
  or hazardous waste sites, or historical resources applies;
  2. Approved, pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(7)(i) and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.1. of the
  Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), a Class 1 Conditional Use permit to allow the construction, use
  and maintenance of a single-family dwelling on a lot fronting a Substandard Hillside Street improved
  with a minimum adjacent roadway width of less than 20 feet, as required LAMC Chapter 1 Section
  12.21 C.10(i)(2);
  3. Approved, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(7)(ii) and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.1,
  a Class 1 Conditional Use Permit to allow the construction, use, and maintenance of a single-family
  dwelling on a lot that does not have a vehicular access route from a street improved with a minimum
  20-foot wide continuous paved roadway from the driveway apron to the boundary of the Hillside Area,
  as required by LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10(i)(3);
  4. Approved, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(1) and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.1, a
  Class 1 Conditional Use Permit to allow a zero-foot front yard setback in lieu of the 19 feet, 10 inches
  otherwise required pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10(a);
  5. Approved, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(3) and Chapter 1A Section 13B.2.1, a
  Class 1 Conditional Use Permit to allow a height of 45 feet in lieu of the maximum height of 28 feet
  otherwise required pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10(d); and
  6. Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicants:  Amir Kazerani and Jaqueline Lopez
  Representative: Norberto F. Nardi, Nardi Associates LLP

  Appellant:  Eagle Rock Hillside Conservation and Safety Coalition
  Representative: Jamie T. Hall, Channel Law Group, LLP
